map.合谷、太冲各取双侧，共四穴。合谷主气、太冲主血，二穴相配可调畅气血、疏肝解郁，是: Take bilateral Hegu and bilateral Taichong, four points in total. Hegu governs qi and Taichong governs blood, and the pair regulates qi and blood, soothes the liver and relieves depression, making it a commonly used paired combination in clinical practice.

map.脏腑病证按俞募配穴法，取背部俞穴与胸腹募穴相配。: For organ and bowel syndromes the back-shu and front-mu pairing method applies, combining the back-shu points with the front-mu points of the chest and abdomen.
map.表里经同病，取原络配穴（如合谷配列缺）贯通表里二经。: When the exterior and interior meridians are affected together, use the source and connecting point pairing (for example Hegu with Lieque) to link the two meridians.
map.调理气机郁滞、情志不舒时，按「开四关」思路取合谷、太冲。: To regulate qi stagnation and emotional discomfort, follow the "Four Gates" approach and take Hegu and Taichong.
map.：调理肝郁气滞，取双侧合谷（手阳明原穴）与双侧太冲（足厥阴原穴），左右共四穴，名: : to regulate liver qi stagnation, take bilateral Hegu (the source point of the Hand Yangming meridian) and bilateral Taichong (the source point of the Foot Jueyin meridian), four points in total, called the "Four Gates", to soothe the liver and regulate qi and blood; then add Xingjian on the same meridian as Taichong to clear liver heat.
